candidate_family.interpretation: k sets the Round-1 scale; d smoothly increases the multiplier toward Round 6.
structural_constraints: all 18 production cells monotone nonincreasing in canonical R1-early through R6-late order
parameters must not finish on a hard search boundary

forbidden: reuse 2024 H2 as a fresh holdout
use KTC/current market/package votes to select k or d
add candidate parameters after seeing V9 Phase 0/1 results
relax a V9 gate after seeing a V9 result

o1_policy.rationale: O1 is replacement-adjusted football utility shape; O2 is the player-equivalent FV scale used for Draft Pick Fundamental Value. V8 showed that forcing <=2% O1 shape movement prevents correcting the repeated O2 Round-6 underpricing conflict.

production_path.future_prospective_audit: 2025 H2 after the 2026 regular season is complete; failure triggers rollback/research review rather than being silently ignored
production_path.phase2_if_pass: versioned production bridge with exact rollback artifact, production snapshot parity, full regression suite, and only PICK_BASE allowed to change

reason_for_v9: V8/V8.1 showed very large O2 scale improvement from global compression.
The repeated failure mode was isolated to Round 6 under a single global multiplier.
V9 therefore tests a low-dimensional smooth round-ramp multiplier that can preserve stronger late-round values without fitting 18 independent cells.

The prior O1 robustness metric is retained as a broad sanity cap rather than the primary FV veto because O2 is the declared Fundamental Value scale target and V8 evidence showed the two shapes conflict materially.

selection_loss.name: balanced_exposed_O2_loss_ratio
tie_breaks: lower maximum individual-cell relative regression across historical H3 and 2024 H2
